question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Trailing-four-quarter operating cash flow covers net income {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value} times and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}, negative, so cash exceeds income. Against the company's own history this is below the prior fiscal year's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and the year before's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, but far above 2022's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}; the annual accruals ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value} sits third highest of five years, after {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value} the year before. The headline ratio nets two large, opposite, one-time flows that both reports name: the prior year's operating cash flow carried the build of the Zawaski accrual inside other accrued liabilities, the six months to June carry its payment, and the same six months carry tariff-refund cash receipts that the release counts in the free-cash-flow increase. None of these is a calculator field, so operating cash flow without them is not there and no adjustment can be sized. Working capital: receivables rose year over year by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change.value}, a share {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income.value} of net income; inventory fell by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} and released cash; payables fell by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change.value}, absorbing a share {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income.value} of net income; trade working capital grew by {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital.value}. Articulation: the receivables gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap.value}, the inventory gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap.value} and the payables gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap.value}; for inventory and payables the balance sheet fell less than the cash-flow statement says, which is what three acquisitions closing in the six months (Allmand, Enercon, Wolter) would produce, since acquired balances enter without passing through the operating lines. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}, below one: quarter-to-quarter changes in net income are about half as volatile as changes in operating cash flow, so income is the smoother series. The quarter's net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct} and operating income {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year.value|pct} on revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct}; the notes say cost of goods sold carries a one-time tariff recovery credit and that the underlying gross margin faced mix and input-cost headwinds, so the jump in earnings is not a jump in earning power. The quarter's operating cash flow derived by Python is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}, up {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.value|pct} on the year-ago quarter but only {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} on the first quarter, while net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} quarter on quarter. On the trailing view net income is {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} and operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} against the prior trailing period. A large six-month change in other operating assets is tagged without explanation, and the Zawaski insurance receivable has no June balance, so how much of the settlement was recovered in cash is not in the input.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: mixed: cash covers income comfortably on a trailing basis and working capital articulates once acquisitions are allowed for, but the quarter's earnings rest on a one-time tariff credit and the six months' cash flow nets a one-time settlement payment against one-time refund receipts, none of which the calculator isolates

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are not outrunning revenue: quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, second lowest of six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} a year earlier; the trailing measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value}; receivables over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue.value}. Three things nevertheless changed in the revenue machinery this quarter. First, a new balance category: contract assets, unbilled receivables on contracts under the cost-to-cost method, rose sharply from the year-end balance (the numbers report tags both balances; the calculator carries neither); the note says revenue recognized on costs incurred exceeds amounts billed, so revenue now rests on cost-to-complete estimates that the critical-estimates paragraph does not name. Second, contract liabilities were redefined as customer deposits; the balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} a year earlier, and the ratio to quarterly revenue {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value} is second highest of six quarters after last quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}; revenue recognized from the opening balance in six months already exceeds the whole of 2025's, so deposits are converting faster. The filed history of this tag carries two different values for the prior year-end under different contexts, so the annual trend is not like-for-like. Third, the standard payment-terms sentence was removed, over-time recognition language sits in the C&I segment description, and the note was retitled to Contract Balances. Remaining performance obligations excluding extended warranty fell from year-end through March to June while the release says data-center backlog rose to a much larger figure; different measures, different dates and a one-year practical expedient may explain it, but nothing in either document reconciles them, and the tag's member name changed between filings. Variable consideration, principal-versus-agent and standalone-selling-price judgments: nothing new found. Fourth-quarter concentration: no fourth-quarter derivation is in the input, so it cannot be tested. Bill-and-hold: nothing found. Extended payment terms: nothing in billed receivables shows them, but the removal of the payment-terms norm in the quarter that introduced hyperscale supply agreements leaves the terms on those contracts unstated.
revenue_recognition.verdict: watch: receivables metrics are clean, but a new over-time method, a sharp rise in unbilled contract assets, a redefinition of contract liabilities and falling remaining performance obligations against a rising backlog are all new this quarter

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance for doubtful accounts is at its thinnest point in the six filled quarters: {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} of gross receivables against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} at the start of 2025; the allowance balance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance.value} while receivables grew to {terms.balances_now.receivables.value}. No collections data is in the input. Standard warranty moved the conservative way: the quarterly ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value} is second lowest of six quarters only because revenue grew, the accrual itself rose to {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual.value}, pre-existing estimates were raised in the quarter, and the annual ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value} was the highest of five years; the extended warranty accrual sits outside every ratio. Against that, the first half includes a release of a 2022 clean-energy warranty provision through the legal add-back table, unquantified. The inventory reserve is in the calculator for no period because the company tags it under a different concept; the 10-K shows the reserve rising through 2025 with a charge to expense, and no 2026 figure exists. Goodwill: the segment reorganization was a triggering event, a small impairment was booked on one Residential unit in the first quarter, the other units passed, and no headroom, discount rate or growth assumption is disclosed; goodwill acquired in the six months is tagged and all three purchase allocations are preliminary. Contingent consideration jumped with the Enercon earnout, which pays on target EBITDA of the acquired unit; its remeasurement runs through earnings but is excluded from adjusted EBITDA. The Ollnova reserve was reduced to a confidential settlement amount, an estimate change that raised GAAP income, unquantified. The tariff refund is accounted for under a newly elected loss recovery model with a receivable recognized on management's probability judgment; the critical-estimates list names only goodwill and income taxes. The effective tax rate rose rather than fell: the trailing rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, above the statutory rate at which the calculator holds it, with the prior year's lower rate attributed to a discrete disposition item; no valuation-allowance release found.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: adverse on disclosure, mixed on direction: the receivables allowance is thinning, three income-raising estimate changes (the Ollnova release, the warranty provision release, the tariff receivable) are unquantified, and the critical-estimates list omits the judgments this filing introduced; warranty and tax move the conservative way

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalized software and capitalized development cost are tagged in no period, so the capitalized-over-expensed ratio is not in the calculator; research and development expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value} over the trailing four quarters is expensed as incurred. Soft assets are not rising: the share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}, the lowest of six quarters, and on the annual view {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}, the lowest of five years, even with goodwill acquired in the six months, because property, plant and equipment grew to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment.value}. What is deferred is a benefit, not a cost: the part of the tariff recovery not credited to cost of goods sold was recorded in inventories and will lower cost of goods sold when that inventory sells; no amount is stated. Non-recurring items that recur: the adjusted metrics remove four immaterial business dispositions this year against one last year, an open-ended legal and regulatory add-back, and contingent-consideration remeasurement, while keeping the one-time tariff refund inside adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDA, the measure used for senior-executive compensation. The non-GAAP gap is not in the calculator because companyfacts carries no non-GAAP measure; the release states adjusted net income above GAAP net income for the quarter, and the asymmetry (losses out, the refund in) widens the gap in the company's favour. The tariff credit would be an earnings adjustment, but no calculator field carries it, so none is written.
cost_deferral.verdict: clean on capitalization, adverse on non-GAAP presentation: no cost deferral found, but the adjusted metrics remove recurring losses and keep a one-time credit

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Proceeds from sale of receivables, supplier-finance obligations, unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee maximum exposure are all absent from the calculator because the company tags none of those concepts in any period; the text carried to the readers names no factoring or supply-chain finance programme, so nothing is found on those, but nothing is testable either. The operating lease liability is stated only at the prior year-end ({ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}). Classification: part of acquisition consideration now bypasses the cash-flow statement, since a Chilicon earnout was paid in shares and treated as non-cash, Enercon's upfront consideration was partly funded with treasury stock, and a share of its earnout is payable in restricted shares; the acquisitions cash of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value} therefore understates what was given up. Customer deposits (contract liabilities) supply operating cash: {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} now against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} a year earlier, cash received ahead of revenue. Operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.value} also carries one-time tariff-refund receipts and, the other way, the Zawaski settlement payment; the release counts the receipts in the free-cash-flow rise. No shifting between operating and investing lines was found. The contractual-obligations paragraph says nothing material changed except borrowings, while the same filing adds an Enercon contingent-consideration current portion, a signed agreement to buy New Way and hyperscale supply commitments, and the release describes aggressive capacity investment with no amount. Variable-interest entities: the Juffali joint venture note carries no change; nothing found. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} is treated as the real cost it is: quality-adjusted free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value} once it and the acquisitions cash are subtracted.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: watch: no factoring or supplier finance is tagged, but acquisition consideration is partly settled in shares outside the cash-flow statement, deposits and one-time refund receipts flatter operating cash, and the obligations paragraph is silent on new commitments

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: This is a 10-Q, so no auditor's report, auditor change or critical audit matter is in the input, and no material weakness is stated; no late filing is listed, no amendment is in the input, no officer departure appears, and no SEC comment letter or subsidiary-list change is in the input. The controls item reports no change in internal control over financial reporting during a quarter in which two acquisitions closed, a cost-to-cost revenue method and contract assets were first disclosed, and a new tariff-recovery accounting election was made; that is silence, not a finding of weakness. Prior-period values are refiled differently across filings: the weighted average short-term borrowing rate at the prior year-end differs sharply between the 10-K and the first-quarter 10-Q, the Allmand payment differs between the 10-K and the first-quarter 10-Q, contract liabilities at the prior year-end carry two values under different contexts, and the remaining-performance-obligation member name changed. Several current tags look mis-scaled (antidilutive shares, program repurchase shares, two extended-warranty timing buckets) and the repurchase authorization carries a different context date than in the prior 10-Q; diluted EPS itself agrees with the release. The subsequent-events note was dropped, leaving post-period matters (the Ollnova settlement, the New Way agreement, the hyperscale terms finalized only in the release) scattered or absent. The head of the residential home power business adopted a prearranged selling plan in the quarter Residential sales fell. Related-party growth: nothing found.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: watch: no control failure is reported, but the tagging record is untidy, prior values move between filings without explanation, the subsequent-events note is gone, and the controls conclusion does not address the quarter's new processes

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K earnings release and the 10-Q agree on the headline lines: net income and diluted earnings per share match the filed facts; the release's quarterly operating cash flow equals the figure Python derives from the six-month and first-quarter filings, {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}; the release's gross margin equals the trend cell {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct}. The effective tax rate the numbers reader could not place is resolved by the notes text: the MD&A states the same rate for both the quarter and the six months, so the six-month tag and the release's quarterly figure are consistent. The two documents word the tariff contribution to gross margin differently, 'to gross margin' versus 'to gross margin growth', but both read as percentage points: the quarter's margin {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} a year earlier is a rise smaller than the stated contribution, which leaves the underlying margin below the year-ago quarter, exactly the mix and input-cost headwind the prose describes. The guidance raise rests on the same refund. Where the documents diverge: the release's data-center backlog rises while the 10-Q's remaining performance obligations fall; the release says the hyperscale terms were recently finalized without a date, so whether the committed volume is in June's obligations is unknown; the acquisitions note calls the deals immaterial while the MD&A and release credit them with growth and capacity; Belvidere appears only in the release. Every notes item with an expected direction is judged in the reconciliation list.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: headline figures reconcile between the 8-K and the 10-Q; the direction items mostly reconcile, with one contradiction (remaining performance obligations versus backlog) and several forward-looking items left unresolved

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: trailing days of inventory are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}; the quarterly figure {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} is third lowest of six quarters but the annual figure {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} was the highest of five years against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} the year before, after a 2025 inventory build; the 10-K's reserve rose through 2025, no 2026 reserve exists in the input, the tariff-refund remainder now sits in inventories lowering carrying cost, and the prose says energy-storage shipments fell after the OBBBA tax-credit phase-out, so the product line most exposed to obsolescence is the one losing demand. Purchase commitments in excess of need: the purchase-obligation concept is not tagged, the MD&A says contractual obligations are unchanged, and the release describes aggressive capacity investment and committed hyperscale volume; nothing can be tested. Customer concentration: the 10-K states no customer above ten percent of sales ({concentration.facts.10.value|pct} for 2025, {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} for 2024) and one customer at {concentration.facts.9.value|pct} of receivables at the 2025 year-end, {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} a year earlier; the two hyperscale supply agreements, one with nearly seven hundred million of 2027 volume against trailing revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.value}, will raise concentration, and the forward-looking list now names cancellation rights in data-center contracts. Channel stuffing: nothing found; receivable days fell, deposits rose, inventory fell, and Residential sales declined rather than being pushed, while the domestic industrial distributor channel shipped less. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the company holds Wallbox warrants and equity securities whose mark-to-market gain reduced other expense this quarter, and it acquired Wolter, a distributor whose relationship to the company's own products the text does not state; nothing shows an investee buying from the company, so unresolved.
industry_lens.verdict: watch: inventory days are high against the company's history with the storage line losing demand, concentration will rise with the hyperscale agreements, no channel-stuffing sign, and the vendor-financing question is unresolved

Whether the recovery was collected inside operating cash flow is not in the input.

anomalies.name: Inventory and payables articulation gaps, consistent with acquired balances
anomalies.name_ko: 재고와 매입채무의 현금흐름표 대 재무상태표 차이, 인수 효과로 설명 가능
anomalies.what: Balance-sheet inventory fell by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} while the cash-flow statement shows a larger release of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change.value}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap.value}; payables show a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap.value} and receivables {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap.value}. Three acquisitions closed in the six months and their balances enter without passing through the operating lines, the benign reading; the allocation is preliminary and not shown.

anomalies.name: Net income moves about half as much as operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 순이익 변동성이 영업현금흐름의 절반 수준으로 더 매끄러움
anomalies.what: Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}, below one, across the nine quarters read. No prose addresses it; seasonal collection and the settlement and refund flows are likely reasons, and the calculator carries no history for the measure.

anomalies.name: Trailing income and cash both down while the quarter surges
anomalies.name_ko: 최근 네 분기 이익과 현금은 줄었는데 이번 분기만 급증
anomalies.what: Trailing-four-quarter net income is {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} and operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} against the prior trailing period, while the quarter shows net income up {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}; the trailing view includes the loss-making fourth quarter of 2025 with its legal fees. The release's framing is quarterly.

anomalies.name: Unbilled contract assets surge with a newly disclosed cost-to-cost method
anomalies.name_ko: 새로 공시된 진행률 방식과 함께 미청구 계약자산 급증
anomalies.what: Contract assets, first disclosed this quarter as unbilled receivables on cost-to-cost contracts, rose sharply from year-end; they sit in prepaid expenses, outside the receivables behind days sales outstanding of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}. Revenue on these contracts depends on cost-to-complete estimates the critical-estimates paragraph does not name. The calculator carries no contract-asset field.

anomalies.name: Remaining performance obligations fall while the release's backlog rises
anomalies.name_ko: 잔여이행의무는 줄었는데 보도자료의 수주잔고는 늘었다고 함
anomalies.what: Remaining performance obligations excluding extended warranty fell from year-end to March to June and the tag's member name changed, while the release says data-center backlog increased to a much larger amount and calls nearly seven hundred million of 2027 volume committed. Different dates, the one-year expedient and orders-versus-contracts are possible reasons, but neither document reconciles them and the release does not date the finalization of the hyperscale terms.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities redefined as deposits; filed history not like-for-like
anomalies.name_ko: 계약부채가 고객 예치금으로 재정의되고 과거 수치가 서로 다름
anomalies.what: The balance {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} a year earlier makes the ratio to revenue {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}, second highest of six quarters, and the annual ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value} the highest of five years. But the prior year-end carries two different values under different contexts and the other-accrued-liabilities table has a separate current contract liabilities line, so whether the rise is deposits or a change in tag scope cannot be told.

anomalies.name: Payment-terms norm removed as over-time contracts begin
anomalies.name_ko: 진행률 계약이 시작된 분기에 표준 결제조건 문장이 삭제됨
anomalies.what: The sentence stating standard payment terms under one year was removed and replaced by a general timing-differences sentence; the C&I description now carries over-time language. Billed receivable days fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, so nothing in billed receivables shows extended terms, but unbilled contract assets rose and the hyperscale agreements' terms are not stated.

anomalies.name: Receivables allowance at its thinnest in six quarters
anomalies.name_ko: 대손충당금 비율이 여섯 분기 중 최저
anomalies.what: The allowance is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} of gross receivables against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} at the start of 2025; the balance fell to {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance.value} while receivables rose to {terms.balances_now.receivables.value}. No prose explains it and no collections data is in the input; the annual ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} sat mid-history.

anomalies.name: Ollnova reserve reduced to an undisclosed settlement amount
anomalies.name_ko: 특허 소송 충당금이 미공개 합의 금액으로 환입됨
anomalies.what: The reserve for the vacated ecobee verdict and interest was reduced to a confidential settlement amount in the quarter, an estimate change that raised GAAP income and appears as a credit in the legal add-back table; neither the amount nor whether the settlement was agreed before June is stated, and no filed fact carries it.

anomalies.name: Release of a 2022 clean-energy warranty provision in the first half
anomalies.name_ko: 상반기에 2022년 청정에너지 보증충당금 환입
anomalies.what: The first-half legal add-back includes a release of a 2022 clean-energy warranty provision, unquantified. Separately, standard warranty moved the conservative way: the accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual.value} and pre-existing estimates were raised in the quarter; the quarterly ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio.value} is second lowest of six quarters only because revenue grew. The extended warranty accrual is outside every ratio.

anomalies.name: Tariff refund receivable recognized on a new probability judgment
anomalies.name_ko: 새 회수가능성 판단으로 관세 환급 채권 인식
anomalies.what: A tariff refund receivable was recorded in prepaid expenses under a newly elected loss recovery model on management's judgment that receipt is probable; no filed fact tags it, no collection timing is stated, and the critical-estimates paragraph does not name it.

anomalies.name: Goodwill tested after reorganization with no headroom disclosed; allocations preliminary
anomalies.name_ko: 조직개편 후 영업권 손상검사, 여유폭 미공시, 배분은 잠정
anomalies.what: The segment reorganization was a triggering event; a small impairment was tagged for one Residential unit in the first quarter, the others passed, and no headroom, discount rate or growth assumption is disclosed; accumulated impairment is large per the 10-K. Goodwill acquired in the six months is tagged and all three purchase allocations are preliminary; soft asset share {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} is nevertheless at a six-quarter low.

anomalies.name: Contingent consideration jumps; Enercon earnout keyed to EBITDA and partly in shares
anomalies.name_ko: 조건부 대가 급증, 에너콘 언아웃은 EBITDA 연동이며 일부 주식 지급
anomalies.what: Contingent consideration rose from the year-end figure to a June figure above the Enercon high-end outcome the first-quarter 10-Q disclosed (the June figure covers more than Enercon); the earnout pays on target EBITDA of the acquired unit, part in restricted shares, and its remeasurement runs through earnings but is excluded from adjusted EBITDA. Diluted shares of {terms.diluted_shares.value} assume certain contingent-consideration conditions are met.

anomalies.name: Critical-estimates list omits the judgments this filing introduced
anomalies.name_ko: 중요 회계추정 목록이 이번 공시에 새로 생긴 판단들을 빠뜨림
anomalies.what: The paragraph names only goodwill and indefinite-lived intangibles and income taxes, while this filing introduces a tariff-recovery probability judgment, cost-to-cost revenue with contract assets, three preliminary purchase-price allocations and a remeasured earnout, each carrying a sizable tagged balance.

anomalies.name: Inventory reserve not visible for any current period
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 평가충당금이 현재 기간에 보이지 않음
anomalies.what: The reserve is in the calculator for no period because the company tags it under a valuation-allowance concept; the 10-K shows it rising through 2025 with a charge to expense, and no 2026 figure exists, so whether the reserve kept pace with days of inventory of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value} cannot be tested.

anomalies.name: One-time refund kept in adjusted metrics while losses are removed
anomalies.name_ko: 조정 지표에서 손실은 빼고 일회성 관세 환급 이익은 남김
anomalies.what: Adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDA include the tariff refund; the reconciliations remove four disposition losses, legal and regulatory items (a credit this quarter), contingent-consideration remeasurement and Wallbox fair-value changes, but no line removes the refund. Adjusted EBITDA is a senior-executive compensation target and the raised outlook includes the refund. The non-GAAP gap is not in the calculator because companyfacts carries no non-GAAP measure; the release states adjusted net income above GAAP net income.

anomalies.name: Immaterial dispositions recur and the legal add-back is open-ended
anomalies.name_ko: 비중요 사업 매각 손실이 반복되고 소송 가산항목 정의가 열려 있음
anomalies.what: Four immaterial dispositions this year against one last year, with a loss on sale tagged for the quarter and goodwill written off in the six months, are added back; the legal add-back covers matters including but not limited to named categories plus certain other specific provisions and large suits and settlements. Items presented as non-recurring recur.

anomalies.name: Tariff refund remainder deferred into inventories
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 환급 잔여분이 재고에 이연됨
anomalies.what: The part of the recovery not credited to cost of goods sold was recorded in inventories, lowering carrying cost now and cost of goods sold when sold; no amount or timing is stated. A benefit is deferred into future margins, and inventory fell by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} year over year partly for this reason.

anomalies.name: Acquisition consideration partly settled in shares outside the cash-flow statement
anomalies.name_ko: 인수 대가 일부가 주식으로 결제되어 현금흐름표 밖으로 나감
anomalies.what: A Chilicon earnout was paid in shares and treated as non-cash; Enercon's upfront consideration was partly funded with treasury stock and a share of its earnout is payable in restricted shares; treasury shares are reissued for contingent consideration. The acquisitions cash of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value} subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow understates the consideration given; no field carries the share-settled portion.

anomalies.name: Customer deposits supplying operating cash ahead of revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 예치금이 매출 인식 전에 영업현금흐름을 떠받침
anomalies.what: Contract liabilities, now defined as customer deposits, are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} a year earlier; the cash sits inside operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.value}. Deposits are real cash but not earned, and six-month revenue recognized from the opening balance shows them converting; the calculator carries no change field, so no adjustment is sized.

anomalies.name: Contractual-obligations paragraph silent on new commitments
anomalies.name_ko: 계약상 의무 문단이 새 약정을 언급하지 않음
anomalies.what: MD&A says no material change to contractual obligations except borrowings, while the filing adds an Enercon contingent-consideration current portion, a signed agreement to buy New Way and hyperscale supply agreements with committed 2027 volume, and the release describes aggressive capacity investment. Purchase-obligation, guarantee and supplier-finance concepts are untagged and absent from the calculator; the operating lease liability is stated only at the prior year-end ({ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}).

anomalies.name: Factoring and supplier-finance concepts untagged
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 매각과 공급망 금융 개념이 태그되지 않음
anomalies.what: Proceeds from sale of receivables and supplier-finance obligations are absent from the calculator because the company tags neither concept in any period; the text carried to the readers names no such programme. Nothing found, but nothing testable; days payables outstanding are {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding.value}.

anomalies.name: No control change reported amid acquisitions and a new revenue method
anomalies.name_ko: 인수와 새 수익인식 방식이 들어온 분기에 내부통제 변화 없음이라고만 보고
anomalies.what: The controls item reports no change in internal control over financial reporting while two acquisitions closed, cost-to-cost revenue and contract assets were first disclosed, and a tariff-recovery election was made; it says nothing about integrating acquired businesses or new revenue processes.

anomalies.name: Prior-period values refiled differently across filings
anomalies.name_ko: 전기 수치가 공시마다 다르게 다시 보고됨
anomalies.what: The weighted average short-term borrowing rate at the prior year-end is stated one way in the 10-K and a very different way in the first-quarter 10-Q; the Allmand payment differs slightly between the 10-K subsequent-event fact and the first-quarter 10-Q; contract liabilities at the prior year-end carry two values under different contexts. No explanation is in the input.

anomalies.name: Mis-scaled tags and changed member names in the current filing
anomalies.name_ko: 현재 공시의 태그 단위 오류와 멤버명 변경
anomalies.what: Antidilutive share counts and program repurchase share counts look scaled differently from earlier filings; two extended-warranty timing buckets look like thousands tagged as dollars; the remaining-obligation member name changed; the repurchase authorization carries a different context date than in the prior 10-Q. Diluted EPS itself agrees with the release and diluted shares are {terms.diluted_shares.value}.

anomalies.name: Subsequent-events note dropped while post-period matters exist
anomalies.name_ko: 후속사건 주석이 사라졌지만 기말 후 사건은 존재
anomalies.what: The prior 10-Q's subsequent-events note is gone and none replaces it; the Ollnova settlement, the New Way agreement and the hyperscale terms finalized only in the release are left undated or outside the 10-Q.

anomalies.name: Residential business head adopts a selling plan as segment sales fall
anomalies.name_ko: 주거용 사업 책임자가 부문 매출 감소 분기에 매도 계획 채택
anomalies.what: The head of the residential home power business adopted a prearranged plan to sell shares and exercise options through year-end in the quarter the Residential segment's sales fell; no program repurchases occurred in the quarter. Not a control matter; listed as a filing signal.

anomalies.name: Tariff contribution worded differently in release and MD&A
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 기여도 표현이 보도자료와 경영진 분석에서 다름
anomalies.what: The release says the refund contributed to gross margin and the MD&A says to gross margin growth. Read as percentage points both fit: the margin {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} a year earlier is a rise smaller than the stated contribution, leaving the underlying margin below the year-ago quarter, the headwind the prose describes.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate period placement resolved by the MD&A
anomalies.name_ko: 실효세율 기간 귀속 문제가 경영진 분석 문장으로 해소됨
anomalies.what: The filed rate is tagged to the six months while the release gives the same rate for the quarter; the MD&A states the same rate for both periods, so there is no gap. The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, above the statutory rate at which the calculator holds it.

anomalies.name: Acquisitions called immaterial yet credited for growth and capacity
anomalies.name_ko: 인수를 중요하지 않다고 하면서 성장과 생산능력 기여로 내세움
anomalies.what: The acquisitions note omits pro forma information as not material, while MD&A states a net sales contribution from non-annualized acquisitions and divestitures, the release credits acquisitions with part of C&I growth and capacity expansion, and acquisitions cash over the trailing four quarters is {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value}. Materiality for pro forma purposes is a judgment the numbers do not settle.

anomalies.name: Belvidere facility and hyperscale terms appear only in the release
anomalies.name_ko: 벨비디어 시설과 하이퍼스케일 계약 조건이 보도자료에만 등장
anomalies.what: The Belvidere facility and the finalization of the first hyperscale product terms appear only in the release; the 10-Q paragraphs carried mention neither, and no subsequent-events note dates them. Property, plant and equipment rose to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment.value}, but the facility cannot be isolated.

anomalies.name: Inventory days high against history while storage demand falls
anomalies.name_ko: 재고일수가 과거 대비 높은데 에너지저장 수요는 감소
anomalies.what: Trailing days of inventory are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}; the annual figure {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} was the highest of five years against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} the year before; the quarterly figure {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} is third lowest of six but far above the earliest quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}. The 10-K's reserve rose through 2025, no 2026 reserve exists, the tariff remainder lowers carrying cost, and energy-storage shipments fell after the tax-credit phase-out.

anomalies.name: Customer concentration set to rise with two hyperscale agreements
anomalies.name_ko: 하이퍼스케일 공급계약 두 건으로 고객 집중도 상승 예정
anomalies.what: The 10-K states no customer above ten percent of sales ({concentration.facts.10.value|pct} for 2025) and one customer at {concentration.facts.9.value|pct} of receivables at the 2025 year-end; nearly seven hundred million of 2027 volume is committed with one hyperscale customer against trailing revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue.value}, a second agreement is unfinalized, and the forward-looking list names cancellation rights and liability exposure in data-center contracts.

anomalies.name: Distributor acquisition and Wallbox investment leave the vendor-financing question open
anomalies.name_ko: 유통사 인수와 월박스 투자로 순환거래 여부가 미확인
anomalies.what: Wolter, an acquired distributor and service provider, may have distributed the company's own products, which would make prior sales to it channel sales now internal; the text does not say. The company holds Wallbox warrants and equity whose mark-to-market gain reduced other expense this quarter; nothing shows Wallbox buying from the company. Unresolved on both.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value}배로 전년도의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배보다는 낮지만 현금이 이익을 넉넉히 웃돕니다. 다만 이번 분기 이익은 일회성 관세 환급 크레딧에 기대고 있고, 상반기 현금흐름에는 일회성 소송 합의금 지급과 관세 환급 수령이 서로 반대 방향으로 섞여 있어 계산기가 이를 분리하지 못합니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권 회수 기간은 분기 기준 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 두 번째로 짧아 매출채권이 매출을 앞지르는 징후는 없습니다. 그러나 이번 분기에 원가 기준 진행률 방식과 미청구 계약자산이 처음 공시되었고, 계약부채가 고객 예치금으로 재정의되어 잔액이 전년의 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value}에서 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value}로 크게 늘었으며, 잔여이행의무는 줄었는데 보도자료의 수주잔고는 늘었다고 말해 두 문서가 맞지 않습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value}로 여섯 분기 중 가장 얇아졌고, 특허 소송 충당금 환입과 관세 환급 채권의 회수가능성 판단처럼 이익을 늘리는 추정 변경은 금액이 적히지 않았습니다. 반면 보증충당금은 {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value}로 늘었고 실효세율도 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}로 올라 보수적인 방향으로 움직였습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 자본화된 개발비는 태그되지 않았고 소프트 자산 비중은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮아 비용 이연의 징후는 없습니다. 다만 조정 지표에서는 반복되는 사업 매각 손실과 소송 비용을 빼면서 일회성 관세 환급 이익은 그대로 두어 비GAAP 지표가 회사에 유리하게 벌어집니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 태그가 없어 계산기에 없습니다. 인수 대가 일부가 주식으로 결제되어 현금흐름표 밖으로 나갔고, 고객 예치금과 일회성 관세 환급 수령이 영업현금흐름을 떠받쳤습니다. 주식보상 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}과 인수 현금을 뺀 조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}로 단순 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}보다 훨씬 작습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 교체, 중대한 취약점, 지연 공시는 없습니다. 그러나 인수 두 건과 새 수익인식 방식이 들어온 분기에 내부통제 변화가 없다고만 적었고, 전기 수치가 공시 간에 다르게 다시 보고되었으며, 여러 태그의 단위가 어긋나고 후속사건 주석이 사라졌습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 보도자료와 10-Q는 순이익, 주당이익, 분기 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}, 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct}에서 일치합니다. 어긋나는 곳은 수주잔고는 늘었다는데 잔여이행의무는 줄어든 점과, 인수를 중요하지 않다고 하면서 성장 기여로 내세운 점입니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수는 최근 네 분기 기준 {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일이고 연간 기준 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 다섯 해 중 가장 길며, 수요가 줄고 있는 에너지저장 제품이 진부화에 노출되어 있습니다. 고객 집중도는 아직 낮지만 {concentration.facts.10.value|pct} 수준에서 하이퍼스케일 공급계약으로 높아질 것이고, 채널 밀어내기 징후는 없으며, 투자처가 회사 제품을 사는지는 확인되지 않습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
